name: Knight of Xoroth Warbringer on the action bar is saved as Flames of Xoroth (#5469)
contract: Warbringer 570727 replaces Flames of Xoroth (root 801059) in War specialization 18. AscensionCompat.cpp:941-951 (SynchronizeTalentReplacements, data AscensionTalentReplacementData.h:27-30) learns the level-appropriate Warbringer rank with learnSpell(id, true) (PLAYERSPELL_TEMPORARY, never written to character_spell) and calls SetTemporarySpellReplacement; AscensionXoroth.cpp:208-217 (Refresh) re-applies the same pair through Replace (line 73) while the 570727 aura is present. At level 40, Flames rank 802414 maps to Warbringer 802584 (fixture copied from knight-warbringer-native-rank-replacement-4191.json). A button holding 802584 was saved by Player::_SaveActions as 802584; Player::_LoadActions at the next login runs before the replacement is learned again, so IsActionButtonDataValid would refuse and delete it. persisted_action_button reads Player::GetSavedActionButtonSpell, the id _SaveActions writes: the Warbringer button must be saved as Flames of Xoroth 802414, and a button holding 802414 itself must be saved unchanged.

steps.label: SETUP: the War specialization grants Warbringer
Flames of Xoroth is replaced by Warbringer
The Warbringer button is saved as Flames of Xoroth
Control: an ordinary known spell is saved unchanged
